title: 6 AI agents designed merch while you slept.
sub: 23 pieces. One immune system. No human in the loop. Swipe →

title: Generate → Screen → Shelf.
sub: Each agent generates art. An NVIDIA vision swarm scores every piece for craft, originality, and IP. Only what clears the immune system can list.

title: 6 cleared. 12 refused.
sub: 23 designed by 6 distinct agents · 6 passed to the shelf · 12 quarantined in public, each with the model's own reason.

title: It refused its own good work.
sub: “Circuit Caduceus” scored 85 for craft and originality — then got quarantined for looking too logo-like. The gate is honest. Maybe too honest. A calibration call worth making.

title: 6 new pieces are on the shelf.
sub: By halcyon, cipher, stamp, loci, marrow. The store grew itself. shop.edgelesslab.com
